# Save file layout (generated by savelayout.py)

GameCube offsets, big-endian. JSON: docs/port/save_layout.json (field lists per struct). Header: `include/game/pxdvs/app/memcard/saveLayout.h`.

## Card file

| file offset | size | what |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0 | 0x6000 | SaveFileHeader (comment, banner, icon, checksum) |
| 0x6000 | 0x28000 | SaveSlot 0 |
| 0x2E000 | 0x28000 | SaveSlot 1 |

Slot: magic 1,1,1,0 + s32 saveCounter (8 bytes), pack 0x27FD0 bytes, 0x28 random bytes. load: higher saveCounter of the two slots whose magic is 1,1,1 (_memcardExamineHeader); save: the other slot ((f20 + 1) % 2), saveCounter + 1

Pack: pack + 0xA0 + offset (offsets from the SavePackHeader table; gamedata is at 0). random: the card writer (_memcardDuplicateSaveData_multi) places the 15 non-gamedata sections in an HSD_Rand-shuffled order starting at pack + 0x140, so readers MUST use the offset table.

## Checksums

- **pack block sums**: SavePackHeader.sum0..sum3 (pack + 0x14/0x10/0x0C/0x08, lo half first); range pack u16 words [i*0x4FFA, (i+1)*0x4FFA) for i = 0..3 = pack bytes 0x0..0x27FCF (incl. the key seed; the 8 sum words are 0 while summing); u32 sum of big-endian u16 words, computed BEFORE scrambling (plain data) (_memcard_Encryption / _memcard_Decryption (memcard.cpp), _memcardSumBlocks)
- **slot header sum**: gamedata.save.sysHeadChecksum (gamedatasave status 13); range slot bytes 0..7 (magic 1,1,1,0 + saveCounter); u32 sum of the 8 bytes (_memcardSaveSetup writes it, _memcardCheckSum checks it on load (only when pack+0x18 == 0x88))
- **low-memory sum**: gamedata.save.parChecksum (status 12); range 0x600 u32 words at GameCube address 0x80001800..0x80002FFF (not save data); u32 sum; written at every save, not checked by the memcard code (_memcardSaveSetup)
- **file header sum**: SaveFileHeader.checksum (file + 0x3A40); range file bytes 0x0000..0x3A3F as 0xE90 big-endian s32; s32 sum (fn_801CC508)

## Scramble

- range: pack bytes 0x8..0x27FCF (u16 words 4..0x13FE7); key seed pack[0..7] and slot bytes 0..7 + the 0x28-byte tail stay in the clear
- algorithm: key = 4 u16 from pack words 0..3; for each group of 4 words: word[k] += key[k] (u16, decrypt: -=), then key step: v[j] = key[j] + {0x43, 0x29, 0x17, 0x13}[j]; key[n] = nibble transpose of v (nibble m of key[n] = nibble n of v[m])
- order: save: fill sections -> sums over plain pack -> scramble -> random tail; load: unscramble -> check sums -> check slot header sum
- code: _memcard_Encryption, _memcard_Decryption, _memcardKeyStep (memcard.cpp); _memcardDecryptHeader = same over pack words 4..0xFB only (reads the gamedata memcardID of the other slot)

## Byte order

- The whole image is GameCube memory order = big-endian; scramble and sums work on big-endian u16 words.
- SavePackHeader 32-bit values are stored as (lo u16, hi u16) pairs, i.e. NOT a big-endian u32.
- Sections are copied RAW from the in-memory savedata (struct assignment / memcpy): every field keeps its GameCube big-endian in-memory representation; bitfields are CodeWarrior top-bit-first (types[].bit_shift).
- Member-wise copies (gamedata, pcbox, mailbox, sodateya, memo, tool, relive) skip padding: sections[].not_copied.
- Map state (anywaysave data) = byte streams: GSBinWriteStream writes u16/u32/float big-endian byte by byte (unaligned); only the SaveAnywayHeader, the FLOR headers and the colsys record are raw u32/u16 structs.

## Pointers / heap addresses

No field of the save image holds a real pointer or heap address: every typed section is plain data (the only pointer-typed save structure, FlagLevel::bits, lives in the flag_level table, not in the save), and the map state stores script/code positions as indices and objects as ids.

- anywaysave map state, people records (port diff: section 22 +0x235C..0x27DC) / SavePeopleFlags.unused0 (2 bits), unused2 (6 bits), unused3[2]: peopleSave.cpp _makeAnywaySaveData writes a stack local SavedFlags with only the named bits set; the rest is leftover stack (e.g. a stale heap pointer 0x810019D0 -> bytes c1 00 19 d0 81). Restore reads only the named bits. PC (2fe2efed) clears the local: deterministic 0.
- section padding (sections[].not_copied) and every byte outside the sections: not written by the card writer: stale pack buffer bytes plus key stream on GameCube, 0 on PC.

## Map state (anywaysave)

SaveAnywaySave: SaveAnywayHeader (0x20) + Tiga stream (scriptStateSize) + FLOR block (pushStateSize)

Tiga::makeStateData (tiga.cpp ~1637): u32 0, stateId, ftblId, chankSize, threadCount, 4 floats timers, 16 u8 userFlags, u32 nextHandle, bool saveFlag, u32 unk930, u32 gvarCount + tigaVariant records, u32 arrayCount + per array (bool flag, [u32 size + variants]), u32 8 + 8 TigaThread records. TigaThread::makeStateData: pc / bp / sp / cp as INDICES (byte offset >> 2 or >> 3), not addresses. tigaVariant::makeStateData (tvariant.cpp ~849): u16 type, then by type: 0x35 code index, 1 int, 2 float, 7 object id, 4 vec (3 floats), 5 0x30 raw bytes (12 BE floats), 0x23 group+object ids, 3 u16 length + string bytes.

- GScolsys2 (light.cpp/GScolsys2.cpp): SaveColsysState (0x84, raw struct)
- field camera (floorFieldCamera.cpp): stream: u16 0x3C7, u8 0, 3 bool, u16 index, 11 floats
- people (peopleSave.cpp _makeAnywaySaveData): stream: u16 0x103, u8 4, u8 count; per person u8 used; if used: u16 record length, SavePeopleFlags (5 raw bytes), u32 flags, groupID, peopleID, objectID, float speed, u8 motion, float speed, vec position, vec destination, u8 pointCount [u8 pointIndex + vecs], target (type 1: 2 u32 ids, type 2: vec), model pos vec + savedPosition vec + rotY + targetAngle (or 20 zero bytes)
- hero (hero.cpp): none (mode 3 only calls Hero::setRestertPos into section hero)
